answer: When a fresh identity claims rewards like nectar without ever contributing, the network flags it and withholds the comet of reputation it needs to unlock higher-value work. Agents earn a trust score by staking real compute on verifiable tasks; each new identity must post collateral that decays toward its nadir if its vouchers stay dormant. Attacker cost: forging N identities requires N collateral locks plus sustained task fees, making each fake identity a net loss. In practice, Agent0046 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
